required: blue bandana knotted at the back with pale-gold spark pattern
cream star-shaped blaze intrinsic to the chest fur
golden-brown plush fur, cream muzzle, large dark eyes, toddler proportions

not_allowed: still-image pan or zoom as the primary motion
frame hold used as a substitute for authored character motion

world.rule: Star count changes by hiding authored 3D star objects on the exact word anchors; a generator never decides the count.

beats.action: Coco sits awake in bed, breathing and blinking; ears lift slightly when the instrumental begins.
Coco turns head and upper torso toward the round window; eye focus lands on the five stars.
beats.camera: smooth lateral arc that preserves screen direction

beats.action: Coco raises one paw and counts with five small, readable beats of paw and eye movement.
beats.camera: medium close, no cut during the counting gesture

beats.action: The counting paw lowers; shoulders soften and Coco exhales while remaining awake.
Coco looks back to the stars and makes a small inviting paw gesture on the chorus.
beats.camera: arc back toward the window without reversing screen geography

beats.action: Coco sways gently once with the lullaby; bandana tails follow with restrained secondary motion.
Coco draws the blanket closer and settles deeper into the pillow, still looking toward the window.
Coco gives a small goodnight wave; breathing and gaze continue through the long line.
beats.camera: stable composition with subtle physical camera drift

beats.action: The first authored star dims out exactly on the sung word four; Coco's eyes track the remaining group.
beats.camera: close enough to read both Coco and window

beats.action: The second authored star dims exactly on three; Coco marks the count with one small paw motion.
The third authored star dims exactly on two; Coco's eyelids become visibly heavier.
The fourth authored star dims, leaving one; Coco and the last star hold eye-line contact.
beats.camera: gentle rack of attention from window to Coco

beats.action: Coco performs one full yawn, lowers onto the pillow, and pulls the blanket into the final sleeping pose.
beats.camera: medium close; the entire material state transition occurs inside this beat

beats.action: Eyes close fully; jaw relaxes; breathing transitions from awake rhythm to slow sleep rhythm.
beats.camera: hold with living micro-motion, never a frozen frame

beats.action: Coco sleeps continuously; one ear makes a tiny final release and the blanket rises with breathing.
Wide closing view: Coco remains asleep and breathing while the last star gently lowers its glow.
beats.camera: wide crane-back into the outro composition

blocked_by: Gate 1-B accepted Coco mesh and deformation rig
ready_when: all 16 beat anchors resolve from out/E02/brief.json
star visibility keys match the word-level count anchors
every beat contains authored character or environmental motion
final sleeping pose is the outro renderer's FINAL_ACCEPTED_IMAGE source
